# `/managed-clusters` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /managed-clusters/v1

`getManagedClustersV1` — Get managed clusters

List current organization's managed clusters, based on request context.

- Scopes: idn:remote-client:manage, idn:remote-client:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `filters` (query) — fields: operational: eq; name: eq; type: eq; status: eq — e.g. `operational eq "operation"`
- Returns 200: array of managedcluster

### POST /managed-clusters/v1

`createManagedClusterV1` — Create create managed cluster

Create a new Managed Cluster. The API returns a result that includes the managed cluster ID.

- Scopes: idn:remote-client:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): managedclusterrequest
- Returns 200: managedcluster

### GET /managed-clusters/v1/{id}

`getManagedClusterV1` — Get managed cluster

Get a managed cluster by ID.

- Scopes: idn:remote-client:manage, idn:remote-client:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Managed cluster ID.
- Returns 200: managedcluster

### PATCH /managed-clusters/v1/{id}

`updateManagedClusterV1` — Update managed cluster

Update an existing managed cluster.

- Scopes: idn:remote-client:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Managed cluster ID.
- Body (application/json-patch+json): array of jsonpatchoperation
- Returns 200: managedcluster

### DELETE /managed-clusters/v1/{id}

`deleteManagedClusterV1` — Delete managed cluster

Delete an existing managed cluster.

- Scopes: idn:remote-client:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Managed cluster ID.
  - `removeClients` (query) — default False — Flag to determine the need to delete a cluster with clients.
- Returns 204: no body

### GET /managed-clusters/v1/{id}/log-config

`getClientLogConfigurationV1` — Get managed cluster log configuration

Get a managed cluster's log configuration.

- Scopes: idn:remote-client:manage, idn:remote-client:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of managed cluster to get log configuration for.
- Returns 200: clientlogconfiguration

### PUT /managed-clusters/v1/{id}/log-config

`putClientLogConfigurationV1` — Update managed cluster log configuration

Update a managed cluster's log configuration. You may only specify one of `durationMinutes` or `expiration`, up to 1440 minutes (24 hours) in the future. If neither is specified, the default value for `durationMinutes` is 240.

- Scopes: idn:remote-client:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of the managed cluster to update the log configuration for.
- Body (application/json): object
- Returns 200: clientlogconfiguration

### POST /managed-clusters/v1/{id}/manualUpgrade

`updateV1` — Trigger manual upgrade for managed cluster

Trigger Manual Upgrade for Managed Cluster. AMS Security: API, Internal A token with SYSTEM_ADMINISTRATOR authority is required to call this API.

- Scopes: idn:managed-cluster-upgrade:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of managed cluster to trigger manual upgrade.
- Returns 200: clustermanualupgrade
